name: AskBidTicks
summary: AskBidTicks is a high-precision tick data collector EA that exports real-time Ask and Bid prices with timestamps to a CSV file. It uses the Windows kernel32.dll GetLocalTime function for millisecond-resolution timestamps, supporting multiple timestamp formats for microstructure analysis. The EA does not open any trades; it purely captures and logs tick data.
summary_zh: AskBidTicks是一个高精度Tick数据采集工具EA，将实时Ask和Bid价格及时间戳导出为CSV文件。它调用Windows kernel32.dll的GetLocalTime函数获取毫秒级精度时间戳，支持多种时间戳格式用于市场微观结构分析。该EA不进行任何交易，纯粹用于采集和记录Tick数据。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个数据采集工具。它的核心功能是在每次Tick事件触发时，记录当前Ask和Bid价格以及高精度时间戳，并将数据写入CSV文件。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理不涉及，因为没有任何开仓行为。资金管理也不适用，EA不会使用账户余额或风险管理逻辑。该工具的真正价值在于为后续的市场微观结构分析提供高质量的Tick级数据支撑，用户可选择标准时间戳、毫秒级系统时间或相对毫秒数三种格式。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a data collection utility. Its core function is to record the current Ask and Bid prices along with high-precision timestamps on every tick event, writing the data to a CSV file. Entry conditions are not applicable since the EA does not execute any trades. Exit conditions are similarly not applicable. Position sizing is not involved as there are no opening positions. Money management does not apply either, as the EA never uses account balance or risk management logic. The tool's true value lies in providing high-quality tick-level data for subsequent market microstructure analysis, with users able to choose among three timestamp formats: standard, millisecond system time, or relative milliseconds.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: 导出CSV文件名，默认按日期_品种命名
parameters.description_en: Export CSV filename; defaults to date_symbol naming

parameters.name: Delimiter
parameters.description: CSV分隔符选择：Tab、逗号或分号
parameters.description_en: CSV delimiter: Tab, comma, or semicolon

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: 时间戳格式：标准、毫秒系统时间或仅相对毫秒数
parameters.description_en: Timestamp format: standard, ms system time, or relative ms only

pros: 毫秒级精度时间戳，适合微观结构分析
支持多种分隔符和时间戳格式，灵活适配不同分析需求
实现简洁高效，资源占用极低
实时输出到工具箱窗口，便于监控数据流
pros_en: Millisecond-precision timestamps suitable for microstructure analysis
Supports multiple delimiters and timestamp formats for flexible analysis needs
Simple and efficient implementation with minimal resource consumption
Real-time output to the toolbox window for convenient data stream monitoring
cons: 依赖Windows kernel32.dll，无法在非Windows平台运行
没有文件大小限制或滚动写入机制，长时间运行可能产生超大文件
缺少错误恢复机制，文件句柄失效后无法重新创建
未提供数据压缩或二进制格式选项，CSV存储效率较低
cons_en: Depends on Windows kernel32.dll, cannot run on non-Windows platforms
No file size limit or rolling write mechanism; long-running sessions may produce extremely large files
Lacks error recovery; once the file handle is invalid, it cannot be recreated
No data compression or binary format option; CSV storage is relatively inefficient
improvements: 添加文件大小限制和自动滚动分割机制，防止生成过大文件
增加OnDeinit中关闭文件句柄的逻辑，确保数据完整写入磁盘
支持MQL5原生时间函数替代kernel32.dll调用，提高跨平台兼容性
improvements_en: Add file size limits and automatic rolling split mechanism to prevent oversized files
Add file handle closing logic in OnDeinit to ensure data is fully flushed to disk
Support MQL5 native time functions as an alternative to kernel32.dll calls for cross-platform compatibility

risk_points: 不涉及任何交易操作，无资金风险
长时间运行可能耗尽磁盘空间
risk_points_en: No trading operations involved, zero financial risk
Extended running may exhaust disk space
